title: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo

translated_title: 通过极值搜索控制在多智能体强化学习中优化团队行为
translated_abstract: 在协作式多智能体强化学习（MARL）中，智能体必须学会协调各自的动作以实现共同目标。有效协调的一个关键指标是行为多样性，即智能体在给定相同观测的情况下执行不同但互补的控制策略的潜力。尽管行为多样性可以实现角色专业化并产生更丰富的联合行为，但其适当水平高度依赖于具体情境和任务，且调优成本高昂。我们提出了自适应多样性控制（ADiCo），这是一个在训练过程中在线调整行为多样性的双时间尺度框架。在快速时间尺度上，多样性控制（DiCo）将系统多样性调节至目标值。在较慢的时间尺度上，极值搜索控制器（ESC）仅利用平均回合回报来调整该目标值，无需显式模型或多样性-性能关系的解析梯度。我们对ADiCo进行了评估
tldr: 该论文提出ADiCo双时间尺度框架，利用极值搜索控制在线自适应地调整多智能体强化学习中的行为多样性目标，仅需平均回合回报即可优化团队协作性能，无需显式模型或解析梯度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ADiCo, a two-timescale framework that uses extremum-seeking control to adaptively tune behavioral diversity online in multi-agent reinforcement learning, optimizing team coordination using only mean episodic returns without requiring explicit models or analytical gradients.
